newsitem.title: HUNGARY: STERLING FEATURES IN LOW-KEY BCE CURRENCY FUTURES.
newsitem.headline: STERLING FEATURES IN LOW-KEY BCE CURRENCY FUTURES.

text.p: Sterling featured in low trade on Budapest's currency futures market on Wednesday while the Swiss franc, though untraded, saw large falls.
Ther U.K. unit accounted for three-quarters of a modest 1.13 billion forints turnover on the Budapest Commodity Exchange's (BCE), with all trades for December, which rose 0.20 to 319.20 forints.
The Swiss franc saw losses of 1.05, 0.99 and 1.50 for September, December and March which ended at 135.80, 141.51 and 145.00 forints respectively.
Dealers associated the falls with current interest speculation in Switzerland.
Other currencies stayed on the sidelines as traders looked for international movements to trade on, dealers said.
The smaller Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) saw only one trade for 200 lots in the March mark, which ended just 0.02 down at 120.28.
